co2plus_orbital_states.label: Co2+ orbital-state caution
co2plus_orbital_states.description: Formal Co2+ compounds may admit competing orbital states in collinear DFT. Charge-balance screening only; not evidence that every listed calculation changed orbital state. Co3O4 is mixed-valence. CoBiO3 and Sr2CoClO3 (formal Co3+), elemental/intermetallic Co compounds are excluded.

cu_without_u.label: Cu without Hubbard U
cu_without_u.description: The reference MP recipe applies no Hubbard U on Cu; DFT moments and exchange may differ from experiment.

moment_collapse_site_change.label: Moment collapse changes magnetic sites
moment_collapse_site_change.description: In Gd2CuO4 the Cu reference moment collapses; the benchmark magnetic sites are Gd. This cautions against interpreting the gate as experimental Cu order.

itinerant_metal.label: Metal / itinerancy caution
itinerant_metal.description: Conservative elemental/intermetallic set: elemental Fe/Co/Ni plus binary or ternary intermetallics of metals with Ge/Si/Sn/Sb/Bi included as metallic partners, and LiMn6Sn6. These compounds are flagged for interpreting moment-dependent collinear exchange fits, not classified by a computed band gap. Ionic arsenides/phosphides, borides, oxides and chalcogenides are not systematically classified here. Not all sites are asserted to be itinerant.

high_residual_exchange_fit.label: Accepted high exchange-fit residual
high_residual_exchange_fit.description: Reference fit status passed_user_accepted_high_residual; truncated Heisenberg parameters require caution.
